issue.title: test_selected_gate_shell_output_png_snapshot fails: gate output lines never render
issue.description: Visual snapshot test tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_family_panel_gate.py::test_selected_gate_shell_output_png_snapshot fails at assert_page_svg_contains(page, 'gate output line 01') after scrolling #agent-prompt-scroll to y=16 and visual idle. The settling gate shell ('Run deployment preview' renders; its long output with 'gate output line 01'/'truncated' never appears in the exported SVG). Found while implementing the approved Agents-tilde-neighbor removal plan (202609/remove_agents_tilde_neighbor_keymap.md); the failure blocks full just fix-tui-screenshots runs because the maintenance runner refuses all golden writes when the child pytest exits nonzero.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Fails 3/3 on the working tree AND 1/1 on a pristine stash of the same master commit 42acc2979 (verified via git stash baseline), so it is independent of the neighbor-removal changes. Two sibling failures in the same full run (waiting zoom modal timeout, context lanes drift) passed on targeted rerun, but this node fails standalone (.venv/bin/python -m pytest -m visual, 8s call, direct assertion failure, not a timeout).
